findings: No recorded build exit-code — The plan requires npx expo export --platform android --dev false to exit 0 as verification evidence. The commit message records only the subject line; no build output or exit code is present. Run and record the export command output before the next release cut.

hudOverlay wrapper deviates from plan's direct-child structure — HUD elements are wrapped in <View style={s.hudOverlay} pointerEvents="box-none"> rather than placed as direct children of the root View. Functionally equivalent, but the pointerEvents="box-none" propagation through a zIndex-elevated view should be validated on device — confirm that the indoor banner dismiss TouchableOpacity and the back button register taps correctly on Android.
